coverage: LLVM source coverage in gSOAP 2.8.142's XML engine (gsoap/stdsoap2.cpp) and DOM parser (gsoap/dom.cpp), reached by the documented DOM-only route: an xsd__anyType read with operator>> from a std::istream, linked with the soapcpp2-generated soapC.cpp for import/dom.h (built in /work/gen and not counted)
scope_limit: gSOAP resolves namespaces itself: each DOM element and attribute carries the URI it resolved (nstr) next to the qualified name as written, and xmlns/xmlns:* declarations stay as DOM attributes without a namespace. The adapter splits off the local part, counts the declaration attributes and lists the distinct non-empty URIs they bind; attributes are sorted per element as in the other C++ paths. Character data comes from the DOM text of text-only elements and of unnamed mixed-content nodes, trimmed. Comments and processing instructions are not kept in the DOM. The soapcpp2 code generator is built from the same pinned source and run once on gSOAP's own import/dom.h, as the DOM manual documents for DOM-only applications; that generated boilerplate (soapC.cpp, soapH.h, soapStub.h, soap.nsmap) is not part of the measured parser sources.
